newsitem.title: FINLAND: KESKO OPENS HARDWARE SUPPLY DEPO IN MOSCOW.
newsitem.headline: KESKO OPENS HARDWARE SUPPLY DEPO IN MOSCOW.

text.p: Finnish wholesaler Kesko Oy said in a statement it opened a hardware supply depo, Kestroy, in Moscow on Tuesday.
The supply depo is run by Kesthom Oy, a joint venture established by Kesko and Finnish trading house Thomesto Trading Yhtiot Oy.
"The objective of Kestroy is to offer services to Russian construction companies and retailers in the branch," Kesko said.
Kestroy would provide construction materials, hardware, tools, white goods, water and plumbing, interior decoration and gardening equipment, it said.
The goods on offer would be delivered to the 2,100 square metres supply depo near central Moscow from Rautakesko's Yrityspalvelu unit in Finland.
Kesko did not give any net sales target for Kestroy.
